verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is managed sandbox infrastructure, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer MCP-server integration, so the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is network 'protocol controls' that govern remote MCP traffic leaving a sandbox. That is an adjacent egress-control feature, not a documented way to register MCP servers so the product can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Sandbox0 supports HTTP request controls and remote MCP controls over HTTP or HTTPS.
